description: This PHP class 'AttendanceHelper' is part of the 'OrangeHRM' system, specifically within the 'Migration"V5_0_0' namespace. It provides methods to update timezone offsets for punch in/out records in the 'ohrm_attendance_record' database table. It contains a timezone map as a constant and methods to execute SQL update queries via Doctrine DBAL to modify timezone-related fields in attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceHelper
classes.description: A helper class for updating attendance punch-in and punch-out timezone offsets in the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttendanceHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current database connection used by the helper.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: updatePunchInTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-in timezone name in the attendance record based on the provided offset and timezone.

methods.name: updatePunchOutTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-out timezone name in the attendance record based on the provided offset and timezone.
